confidence_intervals: cluster bootstrap resampling calendar weeks of entry (10,000 resamples); results also reported by BTC market state (core/regime.detect on BTC daily)
data_source: Binance spot public REST /api/v3/klines, interval 1d, completed candles only, UTC days
execution: decision at the daily close; fill at the next daily open with slippage; stops checked intrabar (gap through the stop fills at the open); stop fills get stop slippage; fees both sides
pass_criteria_prospective_sample_only: >= 100 signal-book trades in the prospective sample (no historical trades counted)
expectancy > 0R and the week-clustered 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
positive on >= 60% of coins with >= 10 trades; still positive without the best coin
expectancy above the 95th percentile of the frozen random-entry benchmark over the same period
purpose: prospective validation only; not approved for trading; no orders; live trading stays locked

random_benchmark.RS3: on each Monday on which the BTC filter is on, 3 coins drawn at random from those with data; same exits (leave at the next Monday), stop, sizing, costs
random_benchmark.T50: per coin, entry on each day with probability p_coin = share of 2019-2024 days on which T50's entry condition was true for that coin (frozen values below); same exits, stop, sizing, costs

reporting: every update writes a run record; interim results never change the rules

RS3.entry: at Monday's daily close: coin in the top 3 of the universe by 28-day return, its 28-day return > 0, and BTC close > BTC 100-day simple average
RS3.exit: at Monday's close if any entry condition fails -> sell next open
RS3.portfolio_order: universe order when slots are short
RS3.stop: 3 x ATR(14) below the fill price, fixed; no take-profit; no trailing

T50.entry: daily close > highest close of the previous 50 days
T50.exit: daily close < lowest close of the previous 25 days -> sell next open
T50.portfolio_order: universe order when slots are short
T50.stop: 3 x ATR(14) below the fill price, fixed; no take-profit (tp_atr_mult=1000); no trailing
T50.universe_rule: main 9 OF2 coins + the 16-coin holdout fixed by rule in RESEARCH_PROGRAMME.md; a coin with no live Binance data (e.g. delisted EOS) is recorded as unavailable
